verdict: The explicit triangle, bias-one stop-game clause passes source scope, current-primary and full numbered/source-alias comparison in this bounded audit.
findings: Physical 27–29 defines Maker-first turns and bias as up to b Breaker edges. Physical 145 and revised primary Section 8 define stopping immediately at the winning Maker turn, retaining both Maker and free edges and deleting only Breaker edges. A subsequent stage is a new game on the retained board, hence resets ownership. The root standalone preserves these rules and does not accidentally use the ordinary multistage rule that exhausts the board.

Physical 145 expressly singles out H=K3 and b=1. Restriction to that clause is licensed literally rather than inferred from a broad false generalization. The one-edge winning-set case would stop before any Breaker deletion and continue forever, so the arbitrary-H finite n^2 assertion cannot be promoted without a repair. The broader H,b remainder is properly retained separately.

Counting successful stages differs from a duration convention including the final failed stage by at most one and preserves the n^2 leading constant. The source Theta(n^2) observation does not establish existence or value of that constant.

The April 2023 revised primary retains Problem 8.4 with the exact triangle/bias-one clause. Dated searches identified no exact later constant or refutation; this is a bounded status assessment, not a universal openness certificate.
